title: XAYAX - Bang! (ATARI VCS 2600 demo)
channel: MEGA - Museum of Electronic Games & Art
summary: Bang! is an Atari 2600 demo by XAYAX that won first place at the Revision 2014 oldschool demo competition. It fits into a 32k ROM using F8SC bankswitching.
why: Commenters hold it up as proof that 2600 programming is alive in the demoscene and as one of the most impressive demos ever made on the hardware.

quote.text: 2600 programming is alive in the demo scene. This was just created in 2014 and is completely insane
